import pandas as pd
import numpy as np
from sklearn.model_selection import train_test_split
from sklearn.feature_extraction.text import TfidfVectorizer
from sklearn.linear_model import LogisticRegression
from sklearn.metrics import roc_auc_score
import os
import warnings

warnings.filterwarnings("ignore")

# Load data from correct paths
train = pd.read_csv("./input/train.csv")
test = pd.read_csv("./input/test.csv")
sample_sub = pd.read_csv("./input/sample_submission_null.csv")

# Determine expected output column name from sample submission
output_col_name = list(sample_sub.columns)[0]

# Prepare training data
X_train_raw = train["Comment"]
y_train = train["Insult"]
X_test_raw = test["Comment"]

# Remove rows with missing comments or labels
mask_valid = X_train_raw.notna() & y_train.notna()
mask_test = X_test_raw.notna()

X_train = X_train_raw[mask_valid].fillna("").astype(str).tolist()
y_train = y_train[mask_valid].astype(int)
X_test = X_test_raw[mask_test].fillna("").astype(str).tolist()

print(f"Training samples: {len(X_train)}, Test samples: {len(X_test)}")


# Clean text content
def clean_text(text):
    if isinstance(text, str) and len(text.strip()) > 0:
        return text.strip()
    return ""


X_train_clean = [clean_text(x) for x in X_train]
X_test_clean = [clean_text(x) for x in X_test]

# Create proper train/val split for validation (holdout that model NEVER sees during training)
X_tr, X_val, y_tr, y_val = train_test_split(
    X_train_clean, y_train, test_size=0.25, random_state=42, stratify=y_train
)

print(f"Training fold: {len(X_tr)}, Validation fold: {len(X_val)}")

# Vectorize features - fit ONLY on training data
vectorizer = TfidfVectorizer(
    stop_words="english",
    max_features=10000,
    ngram_range=(1, 2),
    min_df=1,
    sublinear_tf=True,
    binary=False,
)

# Transform all data using SAME fitted vectorizer
X_tr_vec = vectorizer.fit_transform(X_tr)
X_val_vec = vectorizer.transform(X_val)
X_te_vec = vectorizer.transform(X_test_clean)

print(
    f"Train features shape: {X_tr_vec.shape}, Val features shape: {X_val_vec.shape}, Test features shape: {X_te_vec.shape}"
)

# Train model
clf = LogisticRegression(
    max_iter=1000,
    C=1.0,
    class_weight="balanced",
    solver="lbfgs",
    n_jobs=-1,
    multi_class="ovr",
    random_state=42,
)
clf.fit(X_tr_vec, y_tr)

# Generate predictions for validation set and compute official AUC metric
y_val_pred_proba = clf.predict_proba(X_val_vec)[:, 1]
val_auc = roc_auc_score(y_val, y_val_pred_proba)
print(f"Hold-out Validation AUC-ROC: {val_auc:.4f}")

# Generate predictions for full test set
test_pred_proba = clf.predict_proba(X_te_vec)[:, 1]
test_pred = np.clip(test_pred_proba, 0.0, 1.0)

# Save predictions to submission directory
os.makedirs("./submission", exist_ok=True)

# Create submission dataframe with EXACT column name from sample template
submission_df = pd.DataFrame({output_col_name: test_pred})
submission_df.to_csv("./submission/submission.csv", index=False)

print(f"Submission saved successfully with {len(submission_df)} predictions")
print(f"Final model AUC-ROC (held out): {val_auc:.4f}")
